name: ComNav MS-SAR5000 Ground-Based Slope Radar
summary: Radar berpresisi tinggi tipe Ground-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar (GB-SAR) untuk pemantauan stabilitas lereng.
summaryEn: High-precision Ground-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar (GB-SAR) engineered for continuous real-time slope stability monitoring.
specs: IP67 All-Weather (Kondisi Hujan, Kabut, Debu Tambang)
Panel Surya Hibrida + Baterai Industri Kontinu
specsEn: Radius up to 5,000 meters (5 km continuous coverage)
IP67 All-Weather (Rain, Dense Fog, Mining Dust)
Hybrid Solar Panel + Continuous Industrial Battery
Native direct integration with TerraPulse-AI platform

advantages.title: 0.1 mm Sub-Milimeter Detection
advantages.desc: Deteksi dini pergeseran mikroskopis lereng tambang sebelum retakan memicu longsoran fatal.
advantages.descEn: Early detection of microscopic slope creep before tension cracks trigger catastrophic failures.

advantages.title: 5.000m Continuous Range
advantages.desc: Cakupan area dinding batuan terbuka hingga 5 km dalam satu unit tanpa reflektor fisik.
advantages.descEn: Covers open rock pit faces up to 5 km in a single unit without physical prisms or targets.

advantages.title: < 2 Menit Rapid Scan Cycle
advantages.desc: Interferometri radar cepat memberikan pembaruan data deformasi mendekati real-time.
advantages.descEn: High-speed radar interferometry provides deformation updates in near real-time.

advantages.title: Integrasi Langsung TerraPulse-AI
advantages.desc: Sinkronisasi otomatis dengan monitoring center TerraWatch 24/7 dan sistem sirine peringatan dini.
advantages.descEn: Automatic synchronization with 24/7 TerraWatch monitoring center and site siren systems.

name: ComNav N2 Palm GNSS / Laser RTK Receiver
nameEn: ComNav N2 Palm GNSS / Laser RTK Receiver
summary: Receiver GNSS saku ultra-ringan dengan modul laser EDM terintegrasi untuk pengukuran titik yang sulit dijangkau.
summaryEn: Ultra-lightweight pocket GNSS receiver with integrated laser EDM for surveying hard-to-reach and hazardous points.
specs: Pengukuran Jarak Laser Presisi Sub-Sentimeter Tanpa Pole
Kamera Visual HD untuk Panduan Stakeout Real-Time
IP68 Alloy Tahan Air & Jatuh 2 Meter
specsEn: Calibration-Free IMU up to 60° Tilt Angle
HD Visual Camera for Real-Time AR Stakeout Guidance
Up to 15 hours of continuous active operation

advantages.title: Modul Laser EDM Terintegrasi
advantages.desc: Ukur titik berbahaya, tebing curam, atau area terhalang tanpa harus menempatkan pole jalon.
advantages.descEn: Measure hazardous berms, steep slopes, or obstructed points without placing a range pole.

advantages.title: Augmented Reality (AR) Stakeout
advantages.desc: Kamera HD menampilkan arah dan posisi titik target langsung di layar controller secara visual.
advantages.descEn: HD camera overlays target directions and offsets directly on the controller screen.

advantages.title: Ukuran Ultra Ringan 170 Gram
advantages.desc: Desain seukuran telapak tangan, sangat nyaman dibawa ke medan berat dan survei seharian.
advantages.descEn: Palm-sized form factor, effortless to carry across harsh terrain for full-day surveys.

advantages.title: IMU 60° Bebas Kalibrasi
advantages.desc: Pengukuran tetap akurat presisi tanpa perlu memegang jalon tegak lurus sempurna.
advantages.descEn: Accurate surveying without needing to level the pole perfectly upright.

name: ComNav T20 Multi-Constellation GNSS Receiver
summary: Receiver GNSS cerdas generasi baru dengan teknologi tracking satelit mutakhir untuk survei presisi tinggi.
summaryEn: Next-generation smart GNSS receiver with advanced multi-constellation satellite tracking for high-precision surveys.
specs: 1.590 Tracking Channels (GPS, BDS, GLO, GAL, QZSS)
IP67, Internal UHF 2W, Bluetooth, WiFi, 4G & NFC
specsEn: 1,590 Tracking Channels (GPS, BDS, GLO, GAL, QZSS)
IP67, Internal 2W UHF, Bluetooth, WiFi, 4G & NFC

advantages.title: Baterai Raksasa 10.000mAh
advantages.desc: Hingga 20 jam kerja kontinu, pengisian cepat 5 jam via USB-PD.
advantages.descEn: Up to 20 hours of continuous work, 5 hours fast charging via USB-PD.

advantages.title: 1.590 Kanal Pelacakan
advantages.desc: Pelacakan multi-konstelasi penuh (GPS, BDS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS) untuk fix yang sangat stabil.
advantages.descEn: Full constellation tracking (GPS, BDS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS) for a rock-solid fix.

advantages.title: IMU Generasi ke-3
advantages.desc: Kompensasi tilt 60° dengan kalibrasi otomatis dan kebal terhadap interferensi medan magnet.
advantages.descEn: 60° tilt compensation with auto-calibration and immunity to magnetic disturbance.

advantages.title: Koneksi Cepat NFC
advantages.desc: Penyambungan instan dengan controller data atau ponsel cerdas Android hanya dengan sekali sentuh.
advantages.descEn: Automatic pairing with data collector or Android smartphone with just a touch.

name: Mars Laser RTK Multi-Constellation Receiver
summary: Receiver GNSS laser cerdas dengan layar sentuh OLED, sensor laser EDM milimeter, dan kamera AR untuk survei medan curam tanpa kompromi.
summaryEn: Smart laser GNSS receiver featuring an interactive OLED touchscreen, millimeter-level laser EDM, and AR camera for uncompromising survey performance on steep terrain.
specs: Jarak ukur hingga 50m dengan akurasi milimeter
specsEn: Measuring range up to 50m with millimeter accuracy

advantages.title: Laser EDM Jarak Jauh
advantages.desc: Menembak titik sulit di lereng terjal tanpa membahayakan surveyor di lapangan.
advantages.descEn: Shoot hazardous points on steep slopes without putting field surveyors in harm's way.

advantages.title: Layar OLED Interaktif
advantages.desc: Monitoring status satelit, baterai, dan mode kerja langsung pada bodi receiver.
advantages.descEn: Monitor satellite status, battery level, and operating mode directly on the receiver body.
